integration_status: Integrated in the local full-library UI with native Mala and silent proxies for other modules
description: Granular texture processor based on Mutable Instruments Beads, with four recording qualities, CV modulation, Seed and Freeze.
long_description: Original Beads design and open-source algorithms by Emilie Gillet / Mutable Instruments. Mala LV2 adaptation and touchscreen editor by Beebo / Hector Lab contributors. The local preview is still being developed toward the original module's functionality and I/O.
credits: Beads and stmlib: Emilie Gillet / Mutable Instruments
Mala LV2 adaptation and Qt editor: Beebo / Hector Lab contributors
